sections.text:
The BHG 114 is a single pressure puffer type SF6 gas circuit breaker with one
break per phase. It is designed for incorporation in the B212 metal clad
switchgear concent and meets the requirements of appropriate standard.

Each of the three horizontal lying circuit breaker poles constitutes together
with the motor wound spring operating mechanism FK 2-2 a single phase operating
unit.
The three poles are fixed to the switchgear supporting structure.

The break employed for the BHG 114 is identical to that of the HGF 100 single
column outdoor puffer type circuit breaker. Owing to the simple design, little
requisite for maintenance and a high reliability have been achieved.
